messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] realtime-api-eu-west1 p99 spike: 2.4s | p95: 850ms | error-rate: 0.4%
maya: seeing the alert, paging on-call now.
maya: @ash_oncall can you grab?
ash_oncall: on it. attaching quick dashboard links: https://grafana/redwood/realtime/summary 
ash_oncall: first quick checks: rolling autoscaler activity high, kvcache hit-rate dropped ~30% in last 4m.
devon: +1 to kvcache drop, I see increased eviction counts on nodepool-gpu-12.
ash_oncall: running quick probe: 
ash_oncall: ```bash
curl -sS https://realtime-api.internal/health | jq '.latency_p99, .kv_cache.hit_rate'
# output
2.3
0.62
```
sam_cs: any customer impact flagged? I'm monitoring top accounts in eu region.
maya: CS alert threshold crossed for streaming sessions > 1s, but no customer-facing errors yet. Sam, hold a watch and ping if it moves.
ash_oncall: mitigation ideas: 1) reduce batch_size from 64->32 on hot routes 2) enable degrade-policy to model-variant 'v1-small' for non-critical traffic 3) temporary kvcache warming on primaries
leo_sre: rolling a small config change to reduce max-batch to 32 on eu cluster now.
leo_sre: ```yaml
patch: autoscaler/scale-config
- max_batch: 32
- cooldown: 15s
```
leo_sre: deployed to canary, monitoring.
ash_oncall: also toggled kv-prefetch to 'aggressive' on canary to prime caches.
incident-bot: NOTE: paging on-call -> ash_oncall; handoff to eng-runtime if persists for 15m.
ash_oncall: after canary, p99 dropped to 1.1s, p95 ~520ms; kv hit-rate recovered to ~0.78.
devon: looks like eviction storm from a recent model rollout yesterday; the primary kernel memory pressure coincides. I'm reverting that small kernel change to test.
ash_oncall: reverting model rollout for eu-west1 to previous pinned hash. initiating rollback.
leo_sre: rollback in progress, ETA 4m.
sam_cs: informing engineering customers with active sessions: message queued to customers-eu-list.
sam_cs: message: "We're investigating increased latency in EU streaming; mitigation in progress, no persistent errors expected. We'll update in 10min."
ash_oncall: rollback complete. p99 steady at 620ms, p95 at 340ms.
maya: great. ash_oncall — please escalate to postmortem if root cause is model rollout evictions.
ash_oncall: will open incident doc and assign to eng-runtime + infra. tagging @devon @leo_sre. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Handoff complete — moving thread to incidents/postmortems for follow-up. If any customer impact emerges reopen.
maya: thanks all. closing live mitigation. follow-up action items: write postmortem, add canary mem thresholds to deployment guardrails, improve alert to surface kv miss patterns earlier. :memo:
